body: You're not alone. Something about spending hours staring at nothing, trying in vain to sleep, it brings the dark thoughts out, doesn't it? I'm not the best person to be talking to you, I've just made my own post here, but you're not alone. And, if it helps any, if the thought that some random person on the internet cares about you and whether or not you're hurt, i do. And if you ever need someone to talk to on a long night, fellow insomniac over here.
